author: agent:claude-code
message: The user's decision on formatting under the baseline's new check contract.

text: rustfmt with defaults, applied once in its own commit
why: The user chose (2026-11-02), when baseline 2026.10.22 put `cargo fmt --all --check` among a Rust project's checks (rule checks.contract): reformat the workspace once with rustfmt's defaults (no rustfmt.toml), in a commit holding nothing else, listed in .git-blame-ignore-revs so blame skips it; fmt --check is a check from then on. Before it, 187 files differed from rustfmt (2,622 hunks), mostly hand alignment and long lines. The separate workspaces (bindings/python, bench/rust) follow with the same command run there.
